prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: premium GitHub repository cover and unified scientific concept diagram, wide landscape approximately 2:1.
Primary request: create an exceptionally polished, sophisticated cover for an atlas of AI models for polymer property prediction, polymer structure generation, and target-driven polymer design. Editorial science-cover quality, tasteful and spacious, with a coherent unified schematic rather than a collage of unrelated icons.
Scene/backdrop: deep midnight navy background with subtle gradient and almost invisible geometric texture. Elegant generous negative space. Avoid starfields, sci-fi neon clutter, stock technology aesthetics.
Subject: a large sculptural polymer chain as the central visual anchor, with many connected repeating units and gently curving chain segments. Render atoms and bonds as refined translucent glass and satin metallic spheres/rods with restrained teal and warm amber accents, physically lit, dimensional and exquisite. It must read as a synthetic polymer with repeated connected chemical motifs, NOT a DNA double helix, protein ribbon, brain, or random disconnected spheres. Small tasteful representations of a chemical string, molecular graph, and 3D conformation gather around the central polymer and visually converge into a unified representation hub.
Composition: strong typographic title at upper left with unobstructed space. Central polymer and hub occupy the middle. Three beautifully balanced regions surround it: left property prediction, right structure generation, lower middle goal-driven design. Thin elegant luminous connectors establish a shared polymer-representation hub and three distinct capabilities. Use refined outlined panels or subtly frosted cards integrated into the composition, not heavy flowchart boxes. Maintain readable text at README scale.
Scientific semantics: prediction maps polymer structure/representation to property outputs (show a tiny restrained property response plot and property bars); generation maps a noise or token prior through a generative model to new connected polymer candidates (show a small clear noise-to-structured graph progression); target-driven design maps desired properties through an inverse-design/optimization loop to candidate polymer structures, with a subtle feedback arc from predicted property evaluation to design. These three capabilities share the polymer representation; do not imply that all 22 models are one actual implemented neural network. No fabricated quantitative data, performance metrics, chemistry equations, or specific model names.
Style/medium: premium 3D scientific visualization combined with crisp editorial information design and impeccably set clean sans-serif type. Strong visual hierarchy, meticulous alignment, restrained light bloom, beautiful material texture, excellent contrast. Teal for representation/prediction, muted amber for generation, pale ivory accents for design.
Text verbatim, ONLY the following text: main title "AI FOR POLYMERS"; small subtitle "Awesome-AI4Polymer-Models"; section titles "PROPERTY PREDICTION", "STRUCTURE GENERATION", "GOAL-DRIVEN DESIGN"; central small label "UNIFIED POLYMER REPRESENTATION"; tiny captions "Structure → Properties", "Noise / Tokens → New Structures", "Target Properties → Candidate Polymers".
Constraints: all text spelled correctly and clearly readable; no extra labels, logos, watermarks, brand marks, decorative formulas, duplicate section titles, or screenshots. Unified and grand, exquisite without excess. Balanced scientific meaning and striking visual appeal. Keep all important content inside safe margins. Opaque background.
note: Conceptual cover unifying polymer representation, property prediction, structure generation and goal-driven design. Decorative structures and plots are illustrative, not measured data or a single implemented architecture.
